description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController providing utility endpoints for a backend application, including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, and a health check.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing utility endpoints for root welcome message, documentation redirect, and health status.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome string message for root URL.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI for API documentation.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the application's health status.
